description: Vertical 1080x1920 dark background. Mid-frame (25%-70% height) filled with ~200 tiny muted-grey vertical bars shaking chaotically left-right. Center holds one oversized accent3-yellow golden bar. Bold fg-white headline 'SORTING A MILLION?' sits just above bars in middle band, nothing in top 10% or bottom 25%. Golden bar drops from top-center with scale bounce and shockwave ring.

beats.action: 200 tiny muted-grey bars appear mid-frame shaking chaotically, headline 'SORTING A MILLION?' pops above them in fg-white
shake amplitude doubles and camera pushes in slightly, bars jitter faster
giant accent3-yellow bar slams down into exact center from top with shockwave, all tiny bars flinch outward
everything freezes solid, tiny bars dim to muted-grey, golden bar glows and scales up slightly as headline swaps to 'DON'T SORT'

description: Same dark vertical stage and bar style for continuity. Center band holds a row of ~16 fg-white vertical bars. Overlay of dense accent2-magenta diagonal crossing lines connecting every bar to every other. One center bar designated pivot in accent-cyan glow. Left zone tinted good-green, right zone tinted accent2-magenta for smaller/bigger destinations. No UI in top 10% or bottom 25%.

beats.action: dense web of accent2-magenta comparison lines fades in over white bar row, lines pulse chaotically
comparison lines multiply and flash, bars wobble under overload
all magenta lines fade out to 10% opacity, single center bar turns accent-cyan and glows
pivot bar lifts up, locks center, emits cyan ring and label 'PIVOT' appears above it
three shorter bars slide left into good-green zone with motion blur
three taller bars slide right into magenta zone, pivot stays centered dividing the row

description: Manim 2D algorithm scene, dark background, all action in middle 15%-72% height. Horizontal track mid-frame with five vertical bars labeled 4,1,5,3,2 in fg-white, heights proportional to value. Center pivot bar 3 in accent3-yellow glow. Below track, shallow binary tree nodes form: left pile good-green (1,2) and right pile accent-cyan (4,5) branching lines. Level highlight bands sweep horizontally to show work per level.

beats.action: five labeled bars 4,1,5,3,2 slide in left-to-right onto center track
bar 3 slides to exact center, turns accent3-yellow and lifts with glow pulse
thin fg-white scan line sweeps left-to-right across all five bars, each bar flashes as touched
bars 1 and 2 snap left of pivot, bars 4 and 5 snap right of pivot with spring motion
branch lines grow down from pivot splitting into two pile labels: left pile 1,2 and right pile 4,5
both piles pulse, mini accent-cyan pivots light up inside each pile
horizontal highlight band washes across full width showing one level touching each bar once
pivot shuffles randomly between piles showing roughly even half splits with balance scale wobble
tree depth indicator appears right of tree showing 'log levels -> 1' with shrinking pile icons

description: Continuation of same Manim tree style. Mid-frame holds complete shallow 3-level splitting tree: accent3-yellow root top-center at ~20% height, good-green and accent-cyan branches to 2 piles then 4 leaves, all above bottom 25%. Below tree at ~60% height, large kinetic numbers: good-green '5 MILLION' vs muted-grey giant '25 TRILLION' struck through. Final state morphs leaves into neat sorted row of accent-cyan bars clicking into ascending order.

beats.action: full shallow tree fades in centered, root glows accent3-yellow
camera pulls back slightly, branch lines animate halving pulse down each level
good-green counter '5,000,000 checks' ticks up fast mid-frame below tree
giant muted-grey '25,000,000,000,000' slams behind counter then dims and gets crossed out in accent2-magenta
tree leaves snap into straight ascending accent-cyan sorted bar row that clicks into place with flash
